div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Per joint pitch roll yaw
skip inactive axes
cursor += DofCount

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exponential smoothing
smoothed += target - smoothed * alpha
alpha = 1 - exp -dt/smoothing

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[0] pelvis height y
[1-3] pelvis linearVelocity local
[4-6] pelvis angularVelocity/20
[7-9] pelvis up
[10-12] pelvis forward

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Per joint j in 0..13
[13+7j + 0..3] body.localRotation
[13+7j + 4..6] body.angularVelocity/20

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[111] L foot grounded
[112-114] L foot contact normal
[115] R foot grounded
[116-118] R foot contact normal

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[119] L foot ground ray 0..1
[120] R foot ground ray 0..1
